name: Codenames
description: Two teams race to find their secret agents. Spymasters give one-word clues, and touching the assassin loses on the spot.

intro: **Built from the official rulebook** posted by Czech Games Edition ([PDF](https://filemanager.czechgames.com/storage/files/codenames/rules/CN%20rulebook%20EN%2030.pdf)). This is the current English rulebook.
The text was transcribed from the PDF's pages. Tap any page image to see it as printed.
The rules ask for at least 2 players per team, so 4 is the real minimum. The box says 2–8+ because the free Codenames Companion app adds smaller-group options.
